thread:
alex: Heads-up, vendor pen test arriving next Tues. Need to confirm assessor access model, logs retention, and where they should upload evidence.

maria: Thanks. Can we scope ephemeral access so they only get access during assigned windows? prefer SSO + short-lived roles.

chen: Agreed. We can create OIDC-based ephemeral roles via our IdP. Typical flow: create a role that expires after 8h and is allowed only from vendor group.

alex: Example policy we can give them?

chen: Paste for AWS STS assume role (example):

```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/idp.example.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"idp.example.com:sub":"vendor/assessor-*"},"NumericLessThanEquals":{"aws:EpochTime":"[[EXPIRE_EPOCH]]"}}}
  ]
}
```

alex: Nice. For evidence uploads: we should centralize to a locked S3 bucket with KMS envelope encryption and put an object-lock hold? retention 1 year.

sam: S3 + KMS is fine. Suggest key alias `alias/pt-evidence-redwood` with restricted Decrypt/GenerateDataKey to a small ops group. Also enable key usage logging to CloudTrail and forward to our SIEM.

maria: Important: evidence must have immutability flag and an access checklist. Also auditor shouldn't need to create resources in prod—only readonly view.

alex: Ops, what's the exact upload CLI we give them?

sam: Use this template: `aws s3 cp evidence.tar.gz s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor-<id>/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/pt-evidence-redwood --acl bucket-owner-full-control`

chen: We'll additionally require PutObject to include metadata `x-amz-meta-assessor-id` and `x-amz-meta-assessment-ts`. We'll validate via an S3 Event lambda that tags the object and triggers an ingestion job.

alex: RBAC for read-only: do we give the vendor console access or only signed presigned URLs per object?

maria: Presigned URLs are safer. If they need listing, provide a limited API proxy that enumerates only their prefix. No console access.

alex: About audit logs: retention for 1y is ok but we need faster search during triage. Can we retain 90 days in hot index, 275 in cold?

chen: Yes. Hot: 90d, Cold: 275d. We'll add a derived index that adds `assessor_id` and `evidence_id` to speed queries.

maria: Acceptance criteria for remediation and retest: engineer submits PR + tests, uploads evidence to bucket, and creates a retest request in PT tracker with evidence links. Security triage marks it ready and schedules a retest slot (within 2 weeks ideally).

alex: Who owns tracking? we should avoid orphaned fixes.

sam: Security will own the retest calendar and tagging, but assign a remediation owner in Jira. I'll create a PT epic template and automation to tag `pt:needs-retest`.

sec-bot: JIRA-PT-401 created by @sam for pen test intake checklist (link: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/JIRA-PT-401) :white_check_mark:

maria: One more KMS question — can we do asymmetric signing for evidence chain-of-custody? We could sign manifests to prove immutability.

chen: KMS asymmetric keys could sign manifests (Verify API). We can have ingestion lambda sign a manifest file using the key and store signature as `manifest.sig`. Key use limited to ingestion role.

alex: Great. Timeline sync: vendor runs tests Tue–Thu, initial report due Fri. We triage next Mon, aim to schedule retest window within 10 business days.

maria: I'll publish a small runbook in the PT intake ticket: required artifacts, upload command, RBAC steps, and retest request template.

sam: I'll also prep the S3 bucket policy and an IAM role for ephemeral assessors. Posting draft in the ticket shortly.

alex: Perfect — thanks. If anyone has edge cases (air-gapped evidence, PII), ping me and @maria.

chen: Draft snippet for S3 bucket policy to restrict uploads to assessor prefix: `{"Sid":"AllowAssessorPut","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/assessor-*/*"}`

maria: LGTM. We'll review the automation and run a dry-run upload this Friday. :thumbsup:

alex: Dry-run scheduled. I'll drop the vendor onboarding checklist in the ticket.

sec-bot: Reminder: Scheduled dry-run on Fri 1600 UTC.

sam: Added notes about escalation path and contact list in the ticket.

alex: Thanks all.
